seoTitle: Looking for a removal company in Forest?
seoDesc: Planning a move in Forest? Trust Gérard & Fils to take care of your moving day from start to finish, without the stress.
h1: Your move in Forest with Gérard & Fils

intro.p: Moving house is often an important and sometimes stressful step, but it can also go smoothly when you are well supported. With Gérard & Fils, a family business active for several generations, you benefit from a reliable and personal service for your move in Forest. We want this day to go well for you.

sections.h: A family business at your service in Forest
A team trained for every type of move

body.p: Whether it is a studio, a family home or an office, our team is specially trained to handle your belongings with care. Every remover is trained in the best handling and protection techniques.

Are you moving from an upper floor and the stairwell is too narrow for your furniture? No lift available, or one that is not big enough? Don't worry! Our removal company offers a furniture lift service to solve this problem.

The municipality of Forest is known for the variety of its housing, from houses to apartment buildings. If you are moving anywhere other than the ground floor, or if your doors and windows make it hard to carry your furniture, consider hiring a furniture lift for an easier move. No more racking your brains (or your back) trying in vain to shift furniture that is too bulky. Our removers take your large belongings down and up again with the greatest care and in line with safety standards.
Choose to hire a furniture lift and your body will thank you!

sections.h: Local knowledge that makes the difference

body.p: Our knowledge of every corner of Brussels is a huge asset in our work. Our experienced removers are used to working on moves in Forest and are aware of its logistical constraints: sometimes narrow, one-way streets, large apartment buildings and so on.

Your removal team does everything to deliver a service that lives up to your expectations. Entrust us with the transport of your furniture for your move to one of the greenest municipalities in the capital. We help you settle into your new home, in an area of Brussels that lives to the rhythm of its markets.

sections.h: Forest, a true dog lovers' paradise

body.p: If you have a four-legged companion, you will be delighted to learn that many Forest households walk their dogs in the local parks. Meet up with other dog owners at Parc du Bempt, Parc Jacques Brel or Parc Duden. A little further out, in Beersel, you will find Parc Schaveys: a large expanse of grass, bordered by woodland and fully fenced, where your dog can run around in complete freedom and safety.
Find out how to prepare your pet for your move.

sections.h: Services for every kind of move
Apartment and house removals in Forest

body.p: We take care of every type of home, from small flats to spacious houses, with the same attention. Your furniture, appliances and personal belongings are transported safely.

sections.h: Packing and protection of your fragile items

body.p: Your valuable or fragile items deserve special care. For a calmer move, our removal company can take charge of packing your furniture. We supply boxes, covers and protective materials suited to packing and transporting your furniture.
If you need to store some belongings during your move, we also offer furniture storage rental. Take a look at the options available to you.

Our fleet of modern, well-equipped lorries lets us handle every situation, including difficult access. On top of that, our trailers provide a furniture lift service that adapts to your needs, with a wide choice of lifts.
Contact our experts for more details on the vehicles available.

sections.h: Why choose Gérard & Fils for your move?

body.p: By trusting Gérard & Fils in Forest, you enjoy many advantages:

ul: Over 30 years of experience: our long experience allows us to offer a professional, responsive service suited to every situation.
Transparent prices with no surprises: no hidden costs with us. You receive a clear, detailed quote before any work begins.
Support from A to Z: we stay by your side at every stage (preparation, transport, installation). Your satisfaction is our priority.

sections.h: Contact us today to organise your move!

body.p: Based in Forest, our team naturally works throughout the municipality, but also across the whole Brussels region to support your move wherever your new home is. We regularly travel to Rhode-Saint-Genèse, Etterbeek, Ixelles, Jette, Watermael-Boitsfort, Uccle, Woluwe and Auderghem, with the same rigour whichever municipality you are moving from or to.

Every move is organised to measure: our teams look after packing your boxes, dismantling and reassembling your furniture at the destination, so you don't have to worry about the logistics. Desks, tables, fragile crockery, bookcases full of books: everything is packed and transported with the same level of care, whatever the volume to be moved.

Gérard & Fils therefore guarantees you a punctual service, insured transport and careful handling, at transparent prices set from the initial quote, throughout the Brussels region and its surroundings.
